data.one_liner: A widget to show a navigation drawer with a sliding animation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SlidingDrawer widget that accepts content and drawer builders. It supports left and right positions, custom widths, durations, curves, and gesture handling.
use_when: You need a custom drawer menu with a sliding animation.
You want to support both left and right drawer placements.
avoid_when: You want the standard Material Scaffold drawer implementation.
strengths: Easy to set up with content and drawer builders
Supports customizable width, animation duration, and curve
Allows programmatic opening, closing, and toggling via a GlobalKey
weaknesses: Limited to sliding drawer use cases compared to full UI kits
